detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Causal memory requires not only state persistence but the capacity to influence future dynamics through a reconstructible causal log. This revision distinguishes between passive persistence and functional memory, incorporating evidence on how objective records emerge from environmental redundancy.
